title: Treat a "prints nothing" Check line that is a no-match rg (exit 1) as passing, or read the output and not the exit code

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The implementer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-233556-f24d, project ork, item S388:

Treat a "prints nothing" Check line that is a no-match rg (exit 1) as passing, or read the output and not the exit code

Evidence: round 2 listed `rg -n "Adj\.(Decide|DecideOption)\(" ...: exit 1` with empty output as a failed check, though the slice's Check line says it prints nothing
